newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wheelock duplexes four times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Wheelock duplexes four times subscribed.

text.p: Wheelock and Co Ltd's property arm Wheelock Properties Ltd said on Thursday the market launch of 22 duplex houses at its Forest Hill development in Tai Po in the New Territories was more than four times subscribed.
Of the subscribers, 80 percent were individuals and 20 percent were companies, the developer said in a statement.
The company said it is considering putting more duplexes on the market to meet demand.
The sale will take place on March 15.
